title: CoSTA: Compressed Speech Token Adaptation for Efficient Spoken Dialogue Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21143v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spoken Dialogue Models (SDMs) typically share a speech-token space for generation and synthesis, leading to long autoregressive sequences and costly inference. Lower-rate speech tokenizers shorten sequences but may introduce compression-quality trade-offs and costly replacement without breaking this coupling. To address this limitation, we propose CoSTA, a compatibility-preserving post-hoc framework that decouples generation and synthesis token spaces while retaining the original speech tokenizer and decoder. CoSTA extends the generation token space with compressed representations via mean-initialized vocabulary extension, pronunciation adaptation, and dialogue adaptation, followed by deterministic expansion back to the original speech-token space before synthesis. On bilingual speech-dialogue benchmarks, CoSTA achieves approximately $1.7\times$ expanded speech-token generation speed, lower full-response latency, and higher throughput

translated_title: CoSTA：面向高效口语对话模型的压缩语音词元自适应
translated_abstract: 口语对话模型（SDMs）通常在生成与语音合成之间共享同一个语音词元空间，导致自回归序列过长且推理成本高昂。更低码率的语音分词器虽能缩短序列，但在不打破这种耦合的情况下，可能引入压缩与质量之间的权衡以及高昂的替换成本。为解决这一局限，我们提出了CoSTA，一个保持兼容性的事后适配框架，它在保留原始语音分词器和解码器的同时，将生成与合成的词元空间解耦。CoSTA通过均值初始化的词表扩展、发音自适应和对话自适应，以压缩表示扩展生成词元空间，并在合成之前通过确定性展开映射回原始语音词元空间。在双语语音对话基准测试中，CoSTA实现了约1.7倍的扩展语音词元生成速度、更低的完整响应延迟以及更高的吞吐量。
tldr: CoSTA提出了一种保持兼容性的事后适配框架，利用压缩语音词元将生成与合成的词元空间解耦，在无需替换原始语音分词器和解码器的情况下，将语音词元生成速度提升约1.7倍，同时降低延迟并提高吞吐量。
